summary.interpretation_warning: All results remain exploratory with previously examined model cohort and calibration pairs. A logit-level 2x2 interaction is not proof of a native binding circuit or a necessary interaction for correct task performance (factorized event + role computations may solve it). An oracle supplies the set of four answer options for analysis only; native output is also scored. Voice changes source-token order/length, so the active-passive contrast is not purely one feature.
